title: GOOSE KONG
oneLiner: Guide a determined goose up the girders, leap over barrels, and rescue its friend at the top.
mechanics: Use the tested climber foundation with one goose player, three stages, three lives, and a 100-second limit per life; configure a custom goose avatar and goose rescue target.
Walk left/right on five sloped girders; press Up/Down only at ladders to climb or descend. Press A to jump, with held A producing the full jump and a tap producing a shorter jump.
The gorilla at the upper-left telegraphs each barrel throw; barrels roll downhill, bounce at girder edges, and sometimes take usable ladders. Later stages add fire hazards.
Jumping over each individual barrel awards 100 points once per goose/barrel event. Reaching each new floor awards 100 points once per stage.
Reach the top-right target to rescue it, award the remaining time bonus plus 1000 points, show GOOSE RESCUED!, and advance to the next layout.

A barrel, fire hazard, fall, or timer expiry costs one life. After a hit, show the goose hurt/death animation, respawn at the highest reached floor with temporary protection, and preserve the stage until lives run out.

Stage layouts and hazard cadence escalate across three stages while keeping a guaranteed usable ladder route and bounded simultaneous threats; each stage begins with a brief low-pressure throw cadence.
Clear all three stages to win. Exhausting all lives loses; normal cabinet START/reset behavior handles a new round.
Provide immediate scoring within the first barrel encounter: the skillful action is timing a jump to clear a moving barrel while staying on the current girder and avoiding its edge or ladder route.
artDirection: 256x224 construction-site screens with five rust-orange sloped girders, dark blue-black sky, bright ladders, oil drum, and a large animated gorilla silhouette at upper left. The goose player uses a compact 20x20 maximum avatar compatible with the climber foundation: white body, orange beak and feet, black eye, broad readable wing silhouette, distinct idle, two-frame waddling walk, ladder-climb, airborne wing-out jump, hurt flinch, and death poses. Keep the goose high-contrast against the girders and hazards. Barrels are red-brown rolling circles with bright highlight pixels; fire hazards are orange-red animated sprites; the top rescue target is a small recognizable gosling or goose friend with a waiting and rescued pose. Use the arcade 16-color palette, reserving pale white/yellow for the goose and target and red/orange for hazards and warning effects.

preserve: Single-screen construction-site platforming with sloped girders and ladders
Rolling barrels and fire hazards as escalating threats
Multi-stage progression with a timer and limited lives
change: Replace the player character with a goose while retaining the original climber controller and objectives
The goose is the playable rescuer; the construction-site gorilla remains the hazard source

controls.left: Walk left while grounded on a girder; also steer during a jump.
controls.right: Walk right while grounded on a girder; also steer during a jump.
controls.up: Climb upward when overlapping a usable ladder; otherwise no effect.
controls.down: Climb downward when overlapping a usable ladder; otherwise no effect.
controls.a: Jump while grounded or within the climber's supported jump grace window; holding preserves full height and releasing early shortens ascent.

lose: Lose one life on a barrel, fire, fall, or timer expiry; the game ends when all three lives are exhausted.
scoring: 100 for each new floor, 100 for each barrel jumped once, plus the remaining-time bonus and 1000 for each rescue.
